result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant name in the Fastest near you section and incomplete delivery fee text under a restaurant card.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off on the third card in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Ensure full restaurant names are visible via wrapping, smaller type, or ellipsis with accessible full name (e.g. tooltip), and that card width accommodates typical titles.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the third Fastest near you card appears incomplete as '€1.90 deliver' instead of 'delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Prevent text clipping on card labels so the full '€1.90 delivery' string is always readable.
